message:
I remember the time I thought it would be a great idea to bake cookies during a summer storm. While I was waiting for the power to flicker back on, I ended up with a kitchen full of melted chocolate and a serious lack of air conditioning. It’s funny how we often find ourselves unprepared for the little things, like power outages or extreme heat. 

That’s why I found this resource on heat preparedness quite handy! It’s a gentle reminder to keep our cool and have a plan in place when Mother Nature decides to throw a curveball. 

Ever had a moment where being unprepared turned into a comedy of errors? I'd love to hear your tips or tricks for staying ready!
